question: In ΔABC, AD is a median of the triangle, intersecting BC at D. The three medians of the triangle meet at a point G. If AG = (7y - 3) cm and DG = 3y cm, then find the length of AD.
solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, AD is a median of the triangle, intersecting BC at D

AG = (7y - 3) cm

DG = 3y cm

**Concept used:**

AG: GD = 2 : 1

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75a27b322f75612c9c109f0f7465945e51b5461bba4b980293494a38959a6816.png] 

AG/DG = 2/1

⇒ (7y - 3)/(3y) = 2/1

⇒ 7y - 3 = 6y

⇒ y = 3

Now, AD = AG + GD

⇒ AD = (7y - 3) + (3y)

⇒ AD = 10y - 3

⇒ AD = 30 - 3 = 27 cm

**∴ The length of AD is 27 cm.**
